Job Description: Grande Burrito is a fast food restaurant located in Scarborough ON. We have both Full Time and Part time Burrito Artist positions open. The ideal candidate will possess great interpersonal and organizational skills. The ability to work in a fast\-paced environment and work well with co\-workers. Responsibilities include but are not limited to:

* Serving customer orders in a clean and friendly manner
* Replenish condiments, topping and other supplies
* Help in maintaining kitchen supply up to required level
* Keep your working area clean, prepared and safe
* Clear and clean tables, trays in eating area
* Fill all products that are low on stock
* Keep up to date on all important information from Manager

Qualifications:

* Experience in food industry
* Reliable, hardworking and organized
* Takes initiative and stay sanitary

Only those candidates who are deemed qualified will be contacted. Thanks for your interest.

**Please send your resume, availability and whether you’re applying for part time or full time**

Job Types: Full\-time, Part\-time

Pay: $17\.80\-$20\.00 per hour

Benefits:

* Commuter benefits
* Discounted or free food
* Flexible schedule

Experience:

* Customer service: 1 year (preferred)
* Burrito/sandwich: 1 year (preferred)

Work Location: In person
